findings.title: Policy never names OpenAI, but the app sent 12 KB to api.openai.com
Policy says your data stays on your device, but 12 KB went to api.openai.com right after you used the app
api.mixpanel.com was contacted 3 times while idle, about every 10 s
12 KB uploaded to api.openai.com within 5 s of your action
The app sends data to OpenAI, but the policy never says whether your data trains AI models

summary: The policy promises your notes stay on your device and never names an AI company, yet the app sent 12 KB to OpenAI right after you used its AI feature.
